digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command — lock health checks
propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for inspecting held or orphaned locks; operators must manually inspect lock directories to determine holder identity and process liveness

the read-only doctor command must report four lock legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent state and decode v2 owner stamps to extract host, namespace, pid, and start time
holder liveness probes must be same-host only; foreign hosts and other pid namespaces report unprobeable verdict rather than guessing at pid state

lock staleness must come exclusively from lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with no independent age threshold or pid probe; a stale lock becomes a finding and forces exit 1, while a held lock with live holder remains info-only and exit 0
doctor must remain read-only: locks are never reclaimed or deleted, and --repair does not touch lock findings
the feature adds locks and lock_findings JSON envelope keys, updates doctor.schema.json, and must pass module-size cap and schema validation tests
